data.summary: Found 4 expert(s) for svc_payments_api. Recommended: Dev Okafor (Skipped on-leave: Priya Nair)
cypher: MATCH (x:Service {id: $sid}) MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[w:WORKED_ON]->(x) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:RESOLVED]->(i:Incident)-[:AFFECTED]->(x) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t:Team)-[:OWNS]->(x) WITH p, max(coalesce(w.commits, 0)) AS commits, count(DISTINCT i) AS resolved, count(DISTINCT t) AS owner_team WHERE commits > 0 OR resolved > 0 OR owner_team > 0 RETURN p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.status AS status, commits, resolved, owner_team

data.summary: Blast radius (dependencies) for svc_payments_api: found 4 service(s) within 4 hops
cypher: MATCH (x:Service {id: $sid}) MATCH p = (x)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..4]->(s:Service) WITH s, min(length(p)) AS hops RETURN s.id AS id, s.name AS name, s.tier AS tier, hops ORDER BY hops, name
MATCH (s1:Service)-[r:DEPENDS_ON]->(s2:Service) WHERE s1.id IN $ids AND s2.id IN $ids RETURN s1.id, s2.id

data.summary: Blast radius (dependents) for svc_payments_api: found 2 service(s) within 4 hops
cypher: MATCH (x:Service {id: $sid}) MATCH p = (s:Service)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..4]->(x) WITH s, min(length(p)) AS hops OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Customer)-[:USES]->(s) RETURN s.id AS id, s.name AS name, s.tier AS tier, hops, collect(DISTINCT c.name) AS customers ORDER BY hops, name
